sites.name: Shackleton crater rim (best-lit point)
sites.mission: Artemis III candidate area (Peak near Shackleton)
sites.source_note: Best-lit rim point found by LunaHorizon (pipeline/best_lit_rim.py) from NASA LRO LOLA 20 m polar DEM: Sun centre visible 84.8% of hours 2026-2030 at 2 m height (any part of the Sun 90.4%). Crater centre and size from the IAU Gazetteer (planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/5450). Comparable to Glaser et al. (2014, Icarus): 92.3% at the nearby connecting ridge
